column1: # Slovenian pronunciation lexicon for the Piper front-end.
# Why this exists: eSpeak's Slovenian G2P applies ad-hoc German/English rules to
# foreign names — Mozart comes out as [moːzart] (should be [moːtsart]), Bach as
# [baːtsx], Beethoven as [bitxoːvən]. Respelling the name the way Slovenian
# actually adapts it fixes the phonemes.
# Check any entry with:  espeak-ng -v sl -q --ipa "<respelling>"
# Known limitation: eSpeak ignores explicit stress marks, so a few names keep
# its default (usually penultimate) stress. Marked with "stress:".
